IRS990.Desc: ESPERANZA HOUSING AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION ("ESPERANZA"), A CALIFORNIA NONPROFIT CORPORATION, HAS PARTNERSHIP INTERESTS IN VARIOUS LIMITED PARTNERSHIPS AND IS THE SOLE MEMBER OF SEVERAL LLC THAT HOLD PARTNERSHIP INTERESTS. THESE ENTITIES ARE DISCLOSED ON SCHEDULE R. THE LIMITED PARTNERSHIPS ARE DEVELOPED AND OPERATED BY COMMUNITY HOUSINGWORKS ("CHW"), A CALIFORNIA NONPROFIT CORPORATION, AS AFFORDABLE HOUSING FOR LOW-INCOME PERSONS. EACH OF THESE LIMITED PARTNERSHIP'S FILE A SEPARATE PARTNERSHIP TAX RETURN FORM 1065 (FEDERAL) AND FORM 565 (STATE). ESPERANZA'S MISSION TO DEVELOP HOUSING FOR LOW-INCOME PERSONS AND TO PROMOTE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT TO IMPROVE THE HOUSING AND ECONOMIC CONDITIONS OF THE UNDERPRIVILEGED IS FULFILLED THROUGH ITS PARTICIPATION AS A LIMITED PARTNER IN THESE LIMITED PARTNERSHIPS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION IS EXEMPT FROM INCOME TAXES UNDER SECTION 501 (C) (3) OF THE INTERNAL REVENUE CODE AND SECTION 23701(D) OF THE CALIFORNIA REVENUE AND TAXATION CODE. THE ORGANIZATION BELIEVES THAT IT APPROPRIATE SUPPORT FOR ANY TAX POSITIONS TAKEN, AND AS SUCH, DO NOT HAVE ANY UNCERTAIN TAX POSITIONS THAT ARE MATERIAL TO THE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS. THE ORGANIZATION IS NOT A PRIVATE FOUNDATION. THE ORGANIZATION'S RETURNS OF ORGANIZATION EXEMPT FROM INCOME TAX FOR THE YEARS ENDED DECEMBER 31, 2024, 2023, 2022 AND 2021 ARE SUBJECT TO EXAMINATION BY THE INTERNAL REVENUE SERVICE AND STATE TAXKING AUTHORITIES, GENERALLY THREE TO FOUR YEARS AFTER THE RETURNS WERE FILED.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: PART I, LINE 3- METHODS USED BY RELATED ORG. TO ESTABLISH CEO/EXEC. DIR. CO
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: ESPERANZA HOUSING AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION DOES NOT HAVE ANY EMPLOYEES. ALL WAGES PAID ARE RELATED TO COMMUNITY HOUSINGWORKS. COMMUNITY HOUSINGWORKS USES INDEPENDENT PERSONS AND CONTEMPORANEOUS SUBSTANTIATION OF THE DELIVERATION AND DECEISION TO DETERMINE SALARIES FOR THE CEO, OFFICES AND KEY EMPLOYEES.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION A, LINE 3
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION HAS A CONTRACT WITH AN UNAFFILIATED PROPERTY MANAGEMENT COMPANY TO MANAGE THE DAILY OPERATIONS OF ALL THE APARTMENT COMPLEXES.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE 990 IS REVIEWED WITH CHW'S AUDIT COMITTEE ANNUALLY.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: IN CASE OF A CONFLICT OF INTEREST ISSUE, THE BOARD WOULD REVIEW THE SITUATION. THERE HAVE BEEN NO KNOWN CONFLICTS OF INTEREST FOR THE CURRENT TAX YEAR.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION C, LINE 19
